name: Sen say
summary: Sen sấy khô Trà Lý is dried lotus. The Da Nang Fatherland Front’s fair of 22–24 Sep 2023 names it among recognized OCOP products. The fair does not print a village, a star count, or a price.
origin: Named at the Duy Xuyên fair of 22–24 Sep 2023. No village is printed.
howToEat: The fair note does not say how the dried lotus is eaten. The method is Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: The fair does not print a village. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Sen say — dried lotus named at the 2023 fair
seoDescription: The Da Nang Fatherland Front’s 22–24 Sep 2023 fair names sen sấy khô Trà Lý among recognized OCOP products. No village and no price were printed.
